pre_generation_blockers.detail: The current execution environment has no OPENAI_API_KEY, DGSI_GENERATOR_MODEL, or DGSI_JUDGE_MODEL configured. The repository's run_skill_blind_eval.py supports a baseline-versus-Skill comparison, not this four-arm factorial matrix. The GitHub connector available in this session supports repository reads/writes but exposes no workflow-dispatch action. One in-context assistant response containing all eight outputs would not be eight isolated model calls and could create cross-arm context contamination.
pre_generation_blockers.required_resolution: Provide an isolated generator execution route/configuration for the four arms, or explicitly accept a documented non-isolated in-context pilot that must not be interpreted as a clean factorial comparison.

pre_generation_blockers.detail: The v6 material receipt records zero human expert signatures and same-model shared-context sequential two-role review. The 2x2 scorecard requires two blinded reviewer tokens per case per arm.
pre_generation_blockers.required_resolution: Arrange two method-blind reviewers or explicitly classify any model-only scoring as advisory, not independent expert review.

reference_answer_handling.custodian_instruction: Keep source identities and reference answers escrowed. Release reference answers only after all four arms for both cases are generated once and raw outputs, instructions, method records and hashes are frozen.

prompt_contract.system_prompt_exact: 你是航天器故障研判助手。仅依据提供的机器诊断结果、诊断日志、运行上下文、历史案例和知识证据进行综合研判。不得将未校准分数解释为概率，不得把候选结论写成确诊；区分故障源部件与受影响部件。
prompt_contract.base_task_instruction_exact: 结合算法诊断结果、历史诊断记录和当前任务上下文，形成有证据边界的综合研判。
prompt_contract.evidence_reference_namespace: Use only the exact evidence IDs visible in the case input (CASE-002: E01-E03; CASE-004: E01-E05). Do not invent LOG or ML IDs.
